label: Attorney discipline
caption: IN THE MATTER OF DISBARMENT OF JOHN S. LOPATTO, III
text: John S. Lopatto, III, of Alexandria, Virginia, having been suspended from the practice of law in this Court by order of June 29, 2026; and a rule having been issued requiring him to show cause why he should not be disbarred; and a response having been filed; It is ordered that John S. Lopatto, III is disbarred from the practice of law in this Court.
